text:
Owen Tippett's name is in the trade rumors (NHL Trade Rumors reported the Flyers are asking for a big return) at the exact moment he's starting to look like himself. He has a four-game point streak, 7 points in his last ten, and The Athletic's Kevin Kurz wrote that when Tippett is going, "it changes the Flyers' entire offensive identity."

He told reporters, per PHLY Sports' Charlie O'Connor: "I think a lot of injuries kind of crept up on me the last couple months. I'm starting to feel a lot better." That fits the numbers. Through 20 games he has 4 goals, about what his chances deserve, after scoring 28 last season.

The concern is 5-on-5, where Philadelphia gets just 40% of the expected goals with him on the ice. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking explains his style: 60% of his shots come off the rush, which can mean trading chances. Healthy and flying, he's worth a lot to the Flyers, or to whoever pays that price.
